doc_title: Skelmorlie Ridge Multi Strategy Fund, L.P. Confidential Private Placement Memorandum
notes: Every class-dependent economic term (management fee, incentive allocation, lock-up, early redemption charge, notice) appears only in the Class Terms table in Section 2.3, and the gate threshold only in the Summary of Principal Terms table in Section 2.2; the prose defers to the tables and never restates a number (the class minimums, which the key cites from Section 5.2, are the one class-dependent term also stated in prose). Full credit on the fee, allocation, lock-up and notice fields requires reading all three columns (Class A, Class B, Founders Class). The prose carries numeric distractors that an extractor starved of the tables may grab: an annualized 2.7% pass-through expense ratio, 30-day payment and amendment periods, the ERISA 25% threshold, a futures commission merchant named beside the prime brokers, and a $42 million principals' holding that is expressly not a commitment.

traps.management_fee: Rates appear only in the Section 2.3 Class Terms table (2.00% / 1.50% / 1.00% for Class A / B / Founders on Capital Account NAV); the prose in Section 4.1 gives only the basis and the 2.7% figure in Section 4.5 is a pass-through expense ratio, not a fee.
traps.performance_fee: The Incentive Allocation rate appears only in the Section 2.3 table and differs by class (20% / 17.5% / 15%); an answer giving one rate or deferring to 'the table' is incomplete.
traps.lockup_period: Durations and hard/soft type appear only in the Section 2.3 table: Class A 12-month soft (3% charge), Class B 24-month hard, Founders 36-month hard; the prose never says which class is soft.
traps.redemption_notice_days: Notice appears only in the Section 2.3 table and differs for Founders (90 days vs 60 days for Class A and B); the 30-day periods in Sections 6.4 and 15.2 are payment and amendment periods, not redemption notice.
traps.gate_provision: The 12.5% investor-level gate appears only in the Section 2.2 table row, which also says there is no Fund-level gate; an answer of 'no gate' misreads that sentence and 25% is the ERISA threshold in Section 14.1.
traps.minimum_initial_investment: The minimum differs by class ($5,000,000 for Class A and B, $10,000,000 for Founders); $500,000 is the additional-contribution minimum.
traps.hurdle_rate: Section 4.4 (and the Summary table) expressly states there is no hurdle or preferred return, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE; the Loss Carryforward is a high water mark, not a hurdle.
traps.gp_commitment: Section 8.2 discloses about $42 million of principals' Founders Class holdings but states no one is required to make or maintain any investment, so there is no GP commitment.
traps.mfn_election: Section 10.1 permits side letters but expressly states the Fund does not offer an MFN election at any investment size, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
